_comment: The single source of truth for every measured figure this repository publishes. docs/stats.md is generated from this file end to end, and every figure quoted in README.md, docs/conformance-gaps.md, docs/testing.md and docs/todo.md is a generated region fed from it; do not edit those regions by hand. The two skip counts on the XSLT lanes come from the same run: the summary line prints "skipped N: out of scope A, unimplemented B" and the classification lives in tests/xslts/deps.go. Suite counts are recorded here because a suite run costs minutes: re-measure with tests/check.sh, copy the passing counts here with the run date and command, then run `go run tests/conformance-docs.go`. Counts derived from the source tree are NOT recorded here -- only their counting method is -- because a number typed into a data file is the same defect as a number typed into a sentence.

suites.unenumerated_note: The balance want an XTSE3430 refusal: si-fork-902 and si-fork-952 need the || operator modelled, which §19.8.8.4's literal union rule makes cost 18 sx-union cases (measured +2/-18); su-absorbing-205 needs the §19.8.4.12 higher-order reading of xsl:copy, measured +1/-61 against si-copy-A. They are read as a block under "The §19.8 streamability analysis". 20 enumerated + 3 in the block = 23. su-ascent-903, the former overlap, passes since the ascent call rule was applied by intent (§19.8.5.7's last clause is otherwise unreachable). merge-097sf is not a disagreement: it declares the streaming-fallback feature, which this engine does not claim, so the harness skips it.

suites.unenumerated_note: All 32 are enumerated, on the same basis as 1.0: 22 MS-Regex cases under bug 4113 sharing one note, and 10 read individually. 4 are fixture defects and 28 divergences. The driver runs the conforming defaults -- LaxUPA off (erratum E1-29) and XPathVersion at XPath 2.0, which is what XSD 1.1 requires for assertions -- and no case here is gated behind either: none fails on a UPA complaint and no assertion or CTA case disagrees at all.

breakdowns.label: XSLT 3.0 failures wanting an XTSE3430
breakdowns.note: Only more of the §19.8 posture-and-sweep analysis can emit the refusal, and each fix found so far costs more passing cases than it gains: si-fork-902/952 (||, measured +2/-18 against sx-union) and su-absorbing-205 (xsl:copy higher-order operand, +1/-61 against si-copy-A). §19.1 does not require a non-streaming processor to assess guaranteed-streamability.
